characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. Expression: NO smile — mouth set in a firm straight line, eyes fixed on the camera, brows level, grave and steady. FRAMING FIRST: a tight single-person chest-up close-up — head and shoulders fill the frame, the top of the head near the top edge, the frame cut at mid-chest; the face occupies about one third of the frame height; hands NOT visible; NOT a medium shot, NOT a full-body shot. Full-frame 16:9 image, no black bars. Mouth CLOSED (lips together, no teeth visible); facing the camera, looking into the lens. IDENTITY FIRST: the person is EXACTLY the one in reference image 1 — same face shape, jaw, cheekbones, nose, eyes, eyebrows, skin tone, age, hairstyle and eyewear; only the expression, lighting and framing described below change. SETTING: the place is reference image 2 ONLY; the background, furniture, lamps and lighting of reference image 1 must NOT appear. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED keyframe face of this character: reproduce exactly this face, hair, eyewear and wardrobe; ignore its background and framing unless the description below says otherwise. Reference image 2 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders or labels.
